text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day, after the mysterious scream echoed, {0} and the others visited the research facility.
text_block_list.orig_text:
謎の叫び声が轟いた翌日──
{0}たちは、研究所を訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Good afternoon! 
Today, I brought lots of Sata Andagi again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイタ～イ！
今日もサーターアンダギー、
でーじいっぱい持ってきたさ～！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうわうっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Cotton...Candy...chan...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わた……
あ
め……
ちゃん……？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: No way! Was it always this big?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うそっしょ！？　
こんなおっきかったっけ！？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
No, yesterday it was even smaller! 
...Hah! Could it be that they've been subjected
to some sinister ninja technique?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
昨日は
もっと小さかったデス！
……ハっ！　
まさか
良からぬ忍法をかけられたとかデスか！？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you guys... You must be surprised by Cotton Candy-chan's transformation, right? I never expected individuals to merge and become one entity...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
君たちか……
わたあめちゃんの変態は、
驚いただろ……？
まさか
個体同士が、
合体して一体になるなんてね……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But, merge...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
が、
合体……？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: A-Ah... And this merged form is it's true form, it seems.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
そして、
どうやらこの合体したのが、
本来の姿のようなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: What's going on? Did you see them merge, Doctor?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういうことさ～？　
博士は、
合体したところ見てたの〜？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: When I woke up this morning, I saw that the specimens you collected were tightly clinging to each other. It was a behavior I had never seen before, so I observed them for a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今朝起きたら、
君たちが回収した個体同士が体を密着させ合っていてね。
これまでに見たことのない行動だったから、
しばらく観察していたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: And then suddenly, they started trembling, and a resonance phenomenon began between individuals. And in the next moment, this appearance. When I brushed aside the fur, the bodies had become one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうしたら突然震えだし、
個体間で共振現象が始まったんだ。
そして次の瞬間には、
この姿さ。
体毛をかき分けてみたところ、
体は一つになっていたよ。

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうわうっ！

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Perhaps, it had somehow split into smaller parts due to some circumstances. And so, the necessary number of individuals gathered to return to its original state...
text_block_list.orig_text:
恐らく、
なんらかの事情で小さく分裂していたんだろう。
それで
元に戻るために必要な個体数が集まったから、
本来の状態に……

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: It must be the nature of a spirit. Truly fascinating!
text_block_list.orig_text:
妖魔ならではの体質だろうね。
実に興味深いよ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That may be true, but...
Maybe it's also because they started to miss their home~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはそうかもしれないけど、
あと……
きっと
故郷が恋しくなったのもあるんじゃないかな～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: どゆこと？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Look. Yesterday, I was telling Cotton Candy-chan about my hometown~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら。
昨日、
わたあめちゃんに
私の故郷の話を聞かせてあげてたさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
After that, everyone started howling sadly, you know~? 
It's proof that they want to go home~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのあと、
みんな寂しそうに
遠吠えをし始めたでしょ～？
帰りたくなってる証拠さ～

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: At that time, there was even a terrifying scream in the world... Maybe it was because of various things overlapping that they felt stressed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時、
世にも恐ろしい叫び声もありまシタからね……
いろんなことが重なって、
ストレスを感じたのかもしれまセン。

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Sniff sniff...!
text_block_list.orig_text: くんくん……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ Sata Andagi, is that what you are looking for?
I made them today too, so don't worry! Here you go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは〜、
サーターアンダギーを探してるの〜？
今日も作ってきたから
安心するさ〜！　
はい、
どうぞー！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうわうっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! I know it's delicious,
but please calm down a bit~! It tickles~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～！　
おいしかったのは分かったから、
ちょっと落ち着くさ～！
くすぐったいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Just like when she was little,
after eating Sata Andagi, she licked Kaori's face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フム……
小さかった時と同じで、
サーターアンダギーを食べたあとに、
カオリさんの顔を舐めまシタね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Even when she grows up,
it seems like she's still the same on the inside!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大きくなっても、
中身は一緒っぽいね！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: That's how it turned out! Well, it's because she used to be one body, so even her memories from when she was small remain the same.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうことになりマスね！　
元はといえば
一つの体デスから、
小さかった時の記憶も、
そのままということなんでショウ。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: However, now that they've returned to their original state, there might be something else they remember as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
本来の状態に戻ったことで、
なにか
思い出したこともあるかもしれまセン！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! 
Doctor, have you found out anything else?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね～！
博士、
他になにか分かったことはあるの～？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, apart from appearance,
there is currently no new information... 
It's not like it can suddenly start speaking words.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
姿形以外に新しい情報は今のところ……
言葉が喋れるようになったりしたわけではないからね。

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: But! We are still analyzing it now, so we will definitely find it and grasp the clue to our research!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし！　
今も分析を進めているところだから、
必ずや見つけ出し、
研究の手がかりを掴んでみせよう！

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: That being said, please continue to pursue the anomalies that have appeared in Landosol today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ということで、
今日も引き続き、
ランドソルに現れた怪異を追ってくれたまえ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori and the others
text_block_list.text: OHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: おおー！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうわうっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...? What's wrong, Cotton Candy-chan~? 
Could it be that you want to go together~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？　
わたあめちゃん、
どうしたさ～？
もしかして、
一緒に行きたいの～？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: We're not exactly going for a walk, but it might be just right! Let's bring Cotton Candy-chan along too! I think she'll be helpful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちら散歩するわけじゃないけど、
ちょうどいいかも！
わたあめちゃんも連れてこ！　
役に立つと思う！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: どういうことデスか？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Because, isn't this her original form?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
これが元の姿なんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Like Jack, among the other spirit who come from the spirit world, there might be someone who knows about Cotton Candy-chan, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジャックみたいに、
霊界から来てる他のよーまの中に、
わたあめちゃんのこと
知ってる子がいるかもじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Before, she was small and agile, but now she's become really big, so I think she can make a great impression.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前までは
ちっちゃくてすばしっこかったけど、
今はめっちゃ大きくなったから、
いい感じにアピれると思うんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a great idea! Since she stands out like a sore thumb, we might be able to find a clue on how to return her to the spirit world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、
名案デスね！　
ノロシのように目立ちマスから、
霊界への帰し方の手がかりが
得られるかもしれまセン！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's also cramped to be stuck inside this small laboratory all the time, poor thing~ Doctor, what do you think~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
狭い研究所のなかにずっといるのも
窮屈で、
かわいそうだもんね～
博士、
どうかな～？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Well... let's put the analysis of Cotton Candy-chan aside for now, and focus on investigating the scream from last night.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだな……
わたあめちゃんの分析は後回しにして、
今日は、
昨夜の叫び声について調べることにしよう。

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Even though they are monsters... It is true that dogs need to go for walks. It would be a waste if our valuable research material weakened. Take care and have a safe journey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
妖魔とはいえ……
確かに犬には散歩が必要だ。
せっかくの研究材料が弱ってしまっては元も子もないからね。
気をつけていってらっしゃい！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~!
Well then, Cotton Candy-chan, you're coming along too~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でーじありがとうね～！
それじゃ、
わたあめちゃんも一緒に行くよ～！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうわうっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I hope we find some clues~
Doctor's research is important, but so is Cotton Candy-chan~
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにか手がかりがあるといいね～
博士の研究も大事だけど、
わたあめちゃんのこともさ～

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm sure we'll find new information!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫デスよ！　
きっと
新しい情報が
手に入るはずデス！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Because she stands out so much! 
I know her, she comes running towards me with excitement!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そだよ！　
だってこんなに目立つんだもん！
なんか知ってるよーまの子が、
わーって駆け寄ってくるっしょ！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: わんわんっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Cotton candy-chan!? The small one!? 
She's still in town~!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃん！？　
ちっちゃいほうの！？
まだ街に残ってたの〜！？

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!
text_block_list.orig_text: わーーーんっ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Mmm! She charged towards the big fluffy Cotton Candy-chan! And then she dove into its soft and fluffy fur!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ムムっ！　
おっきいほうのわたあめちゃんに、
突進しまシタよ！？
もふもふな毛の中に入って
潜っていったデス！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Purupuru purupuru purupuru...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぷるぷるぷるぷる……！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: What's happening? It started shaking! Hey, hey, hey, didn't the doctor say that they were shaking before they merged?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか震えだしたんですけどー！
ねねね、
合体する前に震えてたって
博士が言ってなかった？

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Woahhhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: わおーーーんっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright... Hmm, I can't seem to find her anywhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よいしょ、
よいしょ……
ん〜、
どこにも見当たらないね〜

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Kaori, what are you doing,
why are you pushing aside Cotton Candy-chan's fur?
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリさん、
わたあめちゃんの毛をかき分けて、
どうしたデスか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I was looking for the little Cotton Candy-chan that just arrived~ But it seems like she's nowhere to be found~ And besides, the trembling has stopped~
text_block_list.orig_text:
今来たちっちゃいわたあめちゃんを探してたんだよ〜
でも、
どこにもいないみたいだね〜
それに、
震えも止まってるさ〜

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Kyahaha! So, does that mean she just fused with the big Cotton Candy-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはー！
じゃあ、
今
ちっちゃいわたあめちゃんと合体しちゃったってこと？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It looks like it, right~! But, it seems there were still some children that we haven't caught yet~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうみたいだね〜！
それより、
まだ私たちが捕まえてなかった子も
いたみたいさ〜

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey, I wonder how many cotton candy-chan's we still haven't caught yet? If they're going to combine, shouldn't we gather all the remaining ones too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねねね、
あとどんくらい捕まえてないわたあめちゃんがいるのかな？
合体するんだったら、
残ってる子たちも
みんな集めちゃわない？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea, isn't it? 
Alright, let's get started... Peehyarara~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは名案デスね！
では、さっそく……
ピーヒャララー♪

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy friends
text_block_list.text: Woof woof woof! Woof woof woof! Woof woof woof!
text_block_list.orig_text: わんわんわんっ！　わんわんわんっ！　わんわんわんっ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! They're still here after all! 
And there are still dozens of them!
This is the perfect opportunity to catch them all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オオー！　
やっぱりまだいまシタね！
しかも
数十匹はいマスよ！　
これにて
一網打尽デース！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey, Wait a minute! Isn't this too much!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとタンマ！　
多すぎじゃね！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Everyone, they're coming this way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
こっちに向かってきてるさー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Well, it was definitely a bit more than I had anticipated.
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
たしかに
思ってたよりも、
ちょっと多かったデスね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
This is no time for jokes~!
It means they're all going to combine, you know!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとどころじゃないし～！
ぜーんぶ合体しちゃうってことっしょ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Make sure to stay away so you don't get caught up in it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな！　
巻き込まれないように離れるさー！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Ba-uwaahh!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうわうっ！！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ah, finally it seems like the trembling has stopped~! 
Good job on the combination~!
Here, have some Sata Andagi~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは〜、
やっと震えが止まったみたいだね〜！
合体おつかれさま〜！　
はい、
サーターアンダギーだよ〜！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Since she combined with everyone who was left in town, her fluffiness level has increased by about twice as much as in the morning, she's super duper cute~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
街に残ってたみーんなと合体したから、
朝より二倍くらいもふもふ度アップして、
超もにカワ〜！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder if she'll be able to enter the laboratory now that she's grown this big. 
I remember it being a tight fit in the morning...
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか、
こんなにおっきくなって、
研究所に入るかな〜？
朝の時で、
けっこー
ギリじゃなかったっけ……？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Moreover, since she has become more noticeable than before, it should be easier to find clues for sure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
さっきよりも
目立つようになりまシタから、
きっと
手がかりも
探しやすくなったはずデス！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's right~! 
Well then, let's restart our search for the supernatural...
I mean, our walk~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね～！
それじゃあ、
散歩……
じゃなくて、
怪異探しを再開するさ～！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey hey, Hidesai! 
Did you notice any new reactions or anything?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねねね、
ヒデサ～イ！
なんか新しいよーまの反応とかあったりした？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? 
With Hidesai's equipment,
shouldn't you be able to understand various things?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どゆこと？
ヒデサイの装備で、
いろいろわかるんじゃないの？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Maybe because her body has gotten bigger, her spiritual power has also become stronger? And because of that, she might be interfering with the reactions of other spirits too~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う〜ん……
体が大きくなったせいで、
霊力も強くなったのかな〜？
それで、
他の妖魔の反応に干渉しちゃってるのかもね〜？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: I thought it would be easier to find clues, but it seems like we're having quite a difficult time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
手がかりが見つかりやすくなったと思いまシタが、
なかなか手こずりそうデスね……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: And speaking of Cotton Candy-chan herself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
当のわたあめちゃんといえば……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... 
Even though it's still the preparation period,
the sales are amazing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
まだ準備期間だっていうのに、
すごい売れ行きよ……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: I have to hurry and place an additional order for ingredients... Otherwise, we'll have to cancel our booth for the day...
text_block_list.orig_text:
急いで材料の追加発注しなくちゃね……
これじゃ当日の出店は
見送りになっちゃうわ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you eat too many sweets, you know!
It's bad for your body to eat like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ～ら、
甘いものばっか食べすぎさ～！
そんなんじゃ体に悪いよ～

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Nom nom!
text_block_list.orig_text: むしゃむしゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: At this rate, by the time of the Halloween Festival, we'll run out of both our money and the food stalls' inventory~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この調子じゃ、
ハロウィンフェスティバルまでに、
私たちのお金も屋台の在庫もなくなっちゃうさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Look! For every bite you take, shall we go for a walk?
I brought you out for a walk for the sake of your health.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら～！　
食べた分、
散歩するよ～？
健康のために、
散歩に連れ出したんだからね～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Because you're the one who's most beloved, it kinda feels like we're already a family. If it weren't for Kaorin, it would have been tough for just us to take care of everything~
text_block_list.orig_text:
一番懐かれちゃってる分、
なんかもう
家族って感じじゃね？
カオりんいなかったら、
うちらだけじゃお世話するの大変だったし〜

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: Woah! Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いたっ！　
あそこだっ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Mmm...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ムムっ……？

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: Is it you guys? The dangerous person who's walking around with a giant monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
君たちだね？
巨大な魔物を連れて歩いているっていう危険人物は！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Oh no! We're dangerous individuals!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やばばば！　
うちら、
危険人物！？

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: Due to inquiries from people preparing for the festival, we are currently considering capturing that monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
祭りの準備をしている人たちからの問い合わせにより、
その魔物の討伐を検討しているところだ。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Do you intend to subdue Cotton Candy-chan!? 
And she's not a monster, but a spirit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃんを討伐デスか！？
それに
魔物じゃなくて、
妖魔デス！

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: Spirits...? I wonder what they are, but that's not the issue. The problem is that there is a risk of damage to the town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
妖魔……？　
なんだろうが、
それは問題ではない。
問題なのは、
街に被害が出る恐れがあるということだ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, calm down~ 
I want you all to take a good look at Cotton Candy-chan~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな落ち着くさ～
わたあめちゃんのことを、
よ～く見てみてほしいさ～？

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Nom nom!
text_block_list.orig_text: むしゃむしゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I wonder~? She's just eating sweets and enjoying them~!
she hasn't done anything wrong at all~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうかな～？　
おいしそうにスイーツを食べてるだけさ～！
な～んにも
悪さなんて、
一つもしてないよ～？

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Indeed, it appears to be so.
For now, there hasn't been any actual harm. 
Besides, she's adorable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
確かにそのようだ。
今のところ、
実害はまだないしな。
それにかわいい……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you just say she's cute?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
今
かわいいって言いまシタね？

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: Did you.. Hear that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
き、
聞こえていたか……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, behold the secret technique of Hell's Ear!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
忍法
・地獄耳の術デース！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: What does that mean?
text_block_list.orig_text: ってことはー？

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, I suppose it's fine... 
Let's postpone the capture for today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まあいいだろう……
今日のところは
討伐を見送ろう。

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text:
But, well. If any actual harm occurs, we,
as the Defenders of the Throne,
will handle it properly. Got it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
だ。
実害が出た場合は、
騎士団としてしっかりと対処をする。
いいな？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I understand~! But it won't come to that~. 
Leave it to us, we'll take care of everything~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってるさ〜！　
けど、
そんなことにはならないよ〜
私たちがしっかりと面倒みるから
任せてほしいさ〜！

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text:
We don't want to hurt such a cute little dog like this... 
Listen, I'm counting on you, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
我々とて、
こんなかわいいわんちゃんを斬りたくはないからな……
いいか、
頼んだぞ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I was super shocked! 
My heart was pounding!
text_block_list.orig_text:
超ビビったー！
心臓バクドキだったし！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: When I thought that finding clues would be easier now that she has grown up, we ended up in a dangerous situation instead...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大きくなったことで
手がかりが見つかると思ったら、
反対に
危険な状態になってしまいまシタね……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: We caught them after all, so we must take responsibility and protect her until the end, right~
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり捕まえた私たちが、
最後まで責任を持って、
しっかり保護しなきゃだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
If she had grown up freely, 
she might have been exterminated like a pest, you know~
text_block_list.orig_text:
野放しのまま大きくなってたら、
もしかしたら害獣として
駆除されてたかもしれなかったからね〜

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: *whine*
text_block_list.orig_text: くぅ～ん……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Cotton Candy-chan, we're right behind you~
Don't worry about a thing~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃん、
私たちがついてるからね～
なんくるないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Bwah!
text_block_list.orig_text: ばうっ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... I've been strolling around the town all day, but I haven't found any leads...
text_block_list.orig_text:
フ～～～ム……
一日中、
街を練り歩きまシタが、
手がかりゼロでシタね……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Not just clues, but you haven't seen any spirits either, right~? 
Halloween is just around the corner, so wouldn't it be nice if more came from the spirit world?
text_block_list.orig_text:
手がかりだけじゃなくて、
よーまも見かけなかったね～
ハロウィンまでもう少しだし、
霊界からもっと来ててもよくね？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I don't think they're completely gone, but it feels like they've gone into hiding...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
いないわけじゃないと思うんだけど、
なんだか影を潜めたって感じさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Jack was talking about a super high-class monster... 
Maybe they're too scared to come out because of that~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジャックが言ってた超特級クラスの妖魔……
もしかしたら、
そいつに怯えて出てこないのかもしれないね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
There's also the matter of yesterday's scream,
so it's better to be cautious~ 
Let's call it a day for now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
昨日の叫び声のこともあるし、
用心するにこしたことはないさ～
今日のところはひとまず
解散にしようか～

text_block_list.name: Cotton candy-chan
text_block_list.text: Wowooooon......
text_block_list.orig_text: わおおーーん……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.orig_text: 翌日──

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Cotton Candy-chan, Good morning! 
Today, I brought lots and lots of Sata Andagi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃん、
ハイタ～イ！
今日もサーターアンダギー、
でーじいっぱい持ってきたさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: .......? Isn't there a response~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………？　
返事がないね～？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you guys... Good afternoon...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
君たちか……
おはよう……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Yo! 
What's up? Professor, you look down, don'tcha?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっす！
どしたの？　
博士、
元気なくね？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Could it be that your research has hit a dead end?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしや、
研究に行き詰まったんデスか？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's right... 
Actually... Cotton Candy-chan disappeared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通りなんだ……
実は……
わたあめちゃんが消えた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どういうことさー！？

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: After you guys delivered it here, it slept outside for one night. Yesterday, did it grow bigger in the town again? It won't go back to the laboratory anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君たちがここに送り届けてくれたあと、
一晩外で寝かしていたんだ。
昨日、
街でまた大きくなっただろう？　
もう研究所には入らなくてね。

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Then, when I woke up this morning and went outside to feed it, it was nowhere to be found...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしたら
今朝起きて餌をあげようと外に出たら、
どこにも姿がなくて……

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: With the Sata Andagi that Kaori left for me, I searched around the research facility, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリ君が置いていってくれたサーターアンダギーを持って、
研究所の周りをあちこち探したが……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I see... Cotton Candy-chan...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか～……
わたあめちゃん……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Kaori, please don't get depressed. I'm sure she'll find a way to return to the spirit world and go back on her own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリさん、
落ち込まないでクダサイ。
きっと
霊界に戻る方法を見つけて、
自力で帰っていったんデスよ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. It's a shame we couldn't let them go, but for Cotton Candy-chan, it's a good thing, right...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そそ。
うちらが帰してあげられなかったのは残念だけど、
わたあめちゃんにとっては
いいことっしょ……？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for comforting me~ 
But, I'm not feeling down~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも
慰めてくれてありがとうね～
けど、
私は落ち込んでないよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
As Suzuna said, it's a good thing, you know~! 
Besides, I'm sure her wild instincts have come back~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スズナの言う通り、
いいことだからね～！
それに、
きっと野生の勘が戻ったんだろうね～！

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, this is the time to feel down! 
It will have a big impact on my research!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいや、
落ち込むところだよ！
私の研究には大きな影響が出るではないか！

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: At first, I thought it was just a spirit from whom no information could be obtained, but in reality, it could be an individual that could be greatly useful for research, you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
初めはなんの情報も得られない妖魔だと思っていたが、
実際は、
研究に大いに役立つかもしれない個体だったんだからね！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm sure something good will happen again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんくるないさ～！　
きっとまたいいことあるさ～！

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: {0}, You said that the new monster's reaction has stopped since yesterday, right? It's probably because of the influence of Cotton Candy-chan, I think.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、
昨日から新しい妖魔の反応が出なくなったと言っていたね？
おそらく、
わたあめちゃんの影響だ、
とも。

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Now that Cotton Candy-chan is gone, 
maybe you can detect something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたあめちゃんがいなくなった今、
もしかしたら、なにか探知できるかもしれない。

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: I will continue analyzing the screams, so please continue to support me today as well. Since my research has returned to square one... well then, I'm counting on you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は叫び声の分析を進めるから、
今日も引き続きよろしく。
研究が振り出しに戻ってしまったからね……
それじゃ、
頼んだよ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: ...Hey hey hey, Kaorin. Are you really okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねねね、
カオりん。
マジでだいじょーぶ？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: That's right. It seemed like I was trying to act tough earlier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうデス。
さっきは
なんだか強がっているように見えまシタ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh my, everyone has figured it out after all, huh~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
みんなには
やっぱりバレてたね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, you know, I'm a little lonely~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当はね、
ちょっぴり寂しいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It was a short time, but since I took care of her,
I wanted to see her off properly~
text_block_list.orig_text:
短い間だったけど、
お世話もしてたから、
ちゃんと見送ってあげたかったさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But, like I said earlier, it's a good thing for Cotton Candy-chan~! So, there's no point in me feeling down~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
さっきも言ったけど、
わたあめちゃんにとってはいいことさ～！
だから、
私が落ち込んでても
仕方ないさ～！

text_block_list.name: Circus Ringmaster
text_block_list.text: So, welcome, come and see! This year, a fun and exciting circus has arrived in Landosol~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よってらっしゃい、
見てらっしゃ～い！
今年もランドソルに、
楽しい楽しいサーカスがやってきたよ～！

text_block_list.name: Circus Ringmaster
text_block_list.text: In a world so rare, a big fluffy dog performs the cutest performance~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
世にも珍しい、
おっきなおっきなふわふわな犬が、
かわいいパフォーマンスをするよ～！

text_block_list.name: Circus Ringmaster
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, the Halloween Festival is about to begin... As a prelude to that, let's enjoy a circus performance~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあさあ、
もうすぐ始まるハロウィンフェスティバル……
その前夜祭として、
サーカスをご覧あれ～！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Huh, wait... Did you just...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ちょ……
今のって……？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
They said it's a fluffy dog! 
Maybe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふわふわな犬
って言ってたデス！
もしかしたら……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Just in case, I'll go check it out. 
Let's go and confirm it here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ！　
万が一ということもありマス。
ここは
確かめに行ってみまショウ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I wonder if they were a member of the circus even though they were a monster~? Maybe they only come from the spirit world at this time of year~
text_block_list.orig_text:
妖魔だけど、
サーカスの一員だったのかな～？
毎年、
この時期だけ
霊界から来てるのかもしれないね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I want to properly say goodbye~! 
It's good that you could go back home, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしそうなら、
ちゃんとお別れの挨拶をしたいさ～！
お家に帰れてよかったね、
って！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Now that that's decided, let's go check out the circus!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうと決まれば、
サーカスに行ってみるデス！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} and the others, seeking clues about the whereabouts of Cotton Candy-chan who vanished overnight,
set off towards the circus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}たちは、
一晩で姿を消したわたあめちゃんの手がかりを求め、
サーカスに向かうのだった。
